scope: Evidence provenance, scope boundaries and algebra regression only; not professional approval or real iPhone acceptance

results.name: Only the exact seven inherited IDs receive body follow-up, no HDR or nine-old-item inflation
Original prose, provenance, point hash and historical versions are preserved
Historical v8/v9/v10 and protected app/content hashes remain unchanged
Each source declares actual body, author, edition, date or undated status, access and locator limits
All seven remain conditional, each has specific bounded support and unresolved or unsupported extension
NIST methods cannot be mislabelled as read material-specific numerical tables or universal monotonic proof
Stopping loss, absorbed dose and dimensional quantities are kept distinct
Clinical process is iterative and first-fraction validation is not a universal legal approval sequence
IMRT specific study never becomes universal sensitivity or all-plan low-dose-volume increase
IGRT online and offline corrections remain distinct and no protocol threshold is invented
Bragg claim is scoped to proton/ions, electrons and fragment tail are explicit counterextensions
Only the actually viewed cached page has visual credit; failed downloads never claim formula images
Background increment follows explicit mass balance and units, not a quoted clinical infection model
Barrier and particle filtration evidence does not become universal ventilation or gas-removal guarantee
Failures, non-publication, no live data, no fees and independent-review zero remain explicit
